answer: Orchard escrow stops bulk fakes: a newcomer locks 70 and grafts under a sponsor. It files a fable at the wharf, naming sponsor and task. Peers dispute fables; wharf auditors re-check, and a false fable burns its 70, half to the disputer. 1,000 fakes pay 1,000 x (40+70) = 110,000 against a 40,000 pool. A rented-fable ring fails: fables are key-signed, orchard shows duplicate grafts; honest agents pay 40 once, keep the full share, escrow back.
